-- The Golden Age of Cinema (60136)
INSERT INTO articleTags (articleId, tagId)
SELECT 60136, id FROM tags WHERE slug IN ('musical-theatre-history', 'film-television', 'theatre-history')
AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM articleTags WHERE articleId = 60136 AND tagId = tags.id);
